units.french:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: transparent production game sprite sheet. Create exactly SIX isolated full-body game characters/objects in an evenly spaced 3-column by 2-row grid, with ample transparent gutters. 1536x1024 landscape. Every sprite entirely inside its own cell, feet near bottom, no text labels, no extra detached items. Input image is ONLY the landscape STYLE reference: match its muted sage and honey palette, storybook 2D hand-painted gouache, simple rounded forms, soft dry brush texture, broad flat color masses, quiet dark sage contours. This is deliberately illustrated 2D art, NOT 3D, NOT miniatures, no glossy highlights, no gold filigree, no realistic armor detail. At game size human sprites only 32px tall: head roughly one-third total height, mitten hands, sturdy short legs, clear separated silhouette. Same 3/4 front-facing view looking slightly right. Weapons and tools kept close to body. Fully transparent background, no ground tiles, tiny soft contact shadow only. Row one order: villager with EMPTY hands near waist and a plain belt (work tools animated separately), warrior with plain shield and short sword, archer holding bow at rest. Row two: cavalry rider on compact rounded pony with simple spear, scout on smaller pony unarmored with rolled blanket, compact wooden wheeled mangonel siege engine with a short throwing arm. Horses have four clear sturdy legs. Only three or four main color masses each. Personality comes from humble clothing and practical objects.
Civilization-specific art direction: French medieval village, late medieval inspiration. Dusty cornflower-blue wool, warm ivory linen, clay leather. Villager has linen coif, blue short smock and cream apron; warrior simple round kettle helmet with muted iron gray, blue padded coat, small plain blue heater shield; archer blue hood and short self bow; cavalry plain blue surcoat, simple kettle helmet, cream pony saddle blanket; scout tan cap blue scarf brown pony. Siege pale oak with blue cloth tie. Absolutely no decorative brass edging, no complex insignia.

unit_and_hero_prompts.hero: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: Pocket Kingdoms menu hero, landscape 1536x1024, transparent background. Input reference is the existing game landscape; follow its quiet sage colors, simplified rounded trees, broad flat shapes, gentle dark sage contours. Paint a warm charming 2D gouache storybook village vignette for a small historical strategy game. Three cozy places connected by a gently curving ochre path: on left, English cream plaster and brown timber cottage with straw thatch, little kitchen garden, a villager in dusty madder red with brown cap carrying a basket; center, French warm limestone market hall with muted cornflower/slate blue roof, a tiny bread stall, a friendly warrior in blue padded coat and simple rounded kettle helmet resting beside plain shield; right, a Mongol ivory round felt ger with muted sage trim, small stocky dun pony and rider in sage wraparound deel robe and soft felt cap, rolled blanket by doorway. Villagers have cute clear 3-head-tall proportions, round heads mitten hands and no tiny facial details. Small shrubs and a rounded tree frame the composition. Each architecture genuinely different but same simple drawn proportions. Joy from familiar everyday details: bread, garden rows, laundry cloth, pony, not ornamental clutter. Lots of breathing room, broad matt color shapes, very restrained dry brush paper grain. NO 3D render, no toy miniatures, no glossy surfaces, no gold filigree, no elaborate stonework, no fantasy decorations, no text. No floating rectangular diorama plinth; natural softly painted ground patch fading into transparent edge. Fully transparent outside vignette. Keep objects low and composition compact so legible in small menu panel.

french_layout_correction.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this SIX-sprite French game character sheet. Preserve the design, palette, gouache texture, character personalities, transparent alpha and all six roles. Fix ONLY sprite sheet layout: EXACT even grid 3 columns and 2 rows with 60px TRANSPARENT empty gutters between ALL objects. Top row objects completely inside y=40..440. Bottom row objects completely inside y=560..970. Each object inside its column with at least 50px side padding. Specifically scale the bottom-left horse and lancer down a little, including spear, so the spear tip is BELOW y=560, never alongside feet of the villager in the cell above. No detached extra pixels, no overlapping bounding boxes between rows, no halo/shadow wash, just tiny contact shadows under feet. 1536x1024, genuinely transparent. Same six sprites in exact same order. Do not add anything or change clothing.

calls.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production transparent building sprite atlas for a small cozy isometric strategy game, not a mockup. Make a wide 4-column by 3-row sheet of EXACTLY TEN isolated buildings; equal-sized invisible cells, generous transparent gutters. Row 1 left to right: town center, house, barracks, archery range. Row 2: stable, farm, resource camp, siege workshop. Row 3: blacksmith, watch tower, EMPTY, EMPTY. No text, numbers, gridlines or labels. Each object centered in its own cell with identical isometric 3/4 overhead front-facing camera. Each whole building and every attached prop must fit inside its own cell and never touch neighbors. Flat genuine transparency everywhere outside objects. No checkerboard drawn into image.
Art direction: soft hand-painted gouache picture-book illustration with rounded slightly imperfect forms, matte muted colors, sparse broad dry-brush texture, soft dark green-brown contours and clear silhouettes. Inspired by a little olive-green landscape with rounded sage trees, muted moss grass, honey stone, tiny warm shrubs. Restrain detail deliberately: two or three large roof planes, a few large windows, no individual tile grids, no carved ornament, no gold filigree, no photographic materials, no rendered 3D miniatures, no toy gloss, no elaborate fantasy castles. Light warm shadows only, not shiny highlights. Slightly friendly squat proportions, adorable but believable buildings. Keep enough dark contours to remain legible at 70px. No miniature display bases or thick grassy platforms; just grounded buildings with a faint close contact shadow. Limit role props to one or two meaningful objects.
CIVILIZATION: medieval FRENCH. A consistent subdued cornflower/slate blue, warm cream limestone, weathered taupe timber, flax cloth palette. Emblem is a single simple pale fleur-de-lis on a modest blue pennant, only on town center and barracks, never ornate. Town center is a cozy low market hall with one round corner tower and blue hipped slate roofs. House is a cream cottage with blue steep roof, a tiny bread oven at side. Barracks is a squat stone guardhouse with one spear rack. Archery range is a stone-and-wood open shed with one straw target. Stable is a low blue-roofed timber shed with one friendly brown horse's head at stall, hay stack. Farm is a simple rectangular planted wheat patch with a short split-rail fence and two broad golden crop rows. Resource camp is an open blue cloth canopy with three broad logs, one stone block and a basket. Siege workshop is a timber hall with one large spare wheel and an unfinished plain wooden catapult arm. Blacksmith is a small stone forge with an open warm-orange hearth, one anvil and a short chimney. Watch tower is a stout cylindrical cream stone tower with small conical blue roof. Make the ten roles distinct and architecturally coherent.

Edit the attached French building sprite sheet. Preserve exactly all ten building roles and their 4-column, 3-row layout, colors and distinctive functional silhouettes, with last two cells empty. Make the art much SIMPLER and softer, closer to a charming illustrated children's-book strategy map: broad rounded matte shapes, only two or three large blue roof paint planes, no grid of individual roof tiles, no regular masonry brick lines, fewer windows, sparse soft brush marks, gentle dark sage outlines, reduced small debris and greenery. REMOVE the diffuse hazy/blurred color wash around the objects entirely. Real transparent background, every sprite isolated with at least 18px fully transparent gutter to adjacent sprites/cell boundaries. Only a tiny close contact shadow under each building. No shiny 3D appearance, no new objects, no ornamentation. Objects should look drawn and painted by one illustrator, not elaborate dollhouse models.

CIVILIZATION: medieval ENGLISH. Warm cream plaster, large dark oak timber braces, honey-ochre thatch, faded madder-red cloth, muted sage vegetation. One simple dusty-red five-petal rose emblem on a small cream pennant, only town center and barracks. Town center is a broad cozy timber-framed guildhall with thatched roof and a small square timber bell turret. House is a little thatched cruck cottage with one cabbage basket. Barracks is a sturdy timber-and-plaster hall with a red cloth over the doorway and one shield rack. Archery range is an open thatched shelter with a tall unstrung longbow and one straw archery butt. Stable is an oak-frame thatched shed with one brown horse head at a stall and a hay bale. Farm is a little rectangular wheat plot, two broad golden crop rows and a short wattle fence. Resource camp is a lean-to thatched shelter with three broad logs and one basket. Siege workshop is a broad timber shed with one large spare wheel and plain wooden catapult arm. Blacksmith is a dark timber forge with a low stone furnace, orange hearth, one anvil and squat chimney. Watch tower is a compact square timber watch post on stout timber legs with a thatched cap. Ten distinct functional silhouettes.
The attached image is ONLY a style and layout reference. Create the ENGLISH architecture described above, not recolored French buildings. Match its simplified roof planes and gentle contours; no individual tile lines. Ensure truly transparent spaces.

CIVILIZATION: medieval MONGOLS, a friendly settled frontier outpost inspired by Mongol camps. Round warm-ivory felt gers, dark wooden doors, broad horizontal ochre straps, faded sage-and-russet trim, plain timber shelters; absolutely no fantasy pagodas, no temples, no modern flags. The emblem is one simple white horsehair standard on an ochre pole, beside town center only. Town center is one large round ger with a small entrance canopy and the horsehair standard. House is one smaller round ivory ger with rolled felt at door and a milk pail. Barracks is a low broad ger with two shields and a spear rack. Archery range is a timber lean-to with a curved bow and one round straw target. Stable is a simple open timber corral shelter with canvas shade and one small brown horse, saddle blanket. Farm represents the settled frontier: a modest irrigated rectangular millet plot with two broad golden rows, a little wooden water trough and low wattle fence. Resource camp is a plain felt awning with three logs, a basket and tied sacks. Siege workshop is a practical timber-and-felt workshop, one large spare cart wheel and one plain catapult arm. Blacksmith is a simple dark felt open-front shelter over a low clay forge with orange coals, anvil and one bellows. Watch tower is a simple square timber lookout platform on stout poles, pale felt canopy. Carefully separate silhouettes even among gers.
The attached image is ONLY a style and layout reference. Create the MONGOL architecture described above, not recolored French buildings. Match its simplified planes and gentle contours; no ornate motifs. Ensure truly transparent spaces.

Edit ONLY the layout of this English ten-building transparent sprite atlas. Preserve the exact ten illustrations, painting, role order, English thatch architecture, shape and colors. Give them spacious transparent gutters in an invisible 4-column by 3-row grid. TOP ROW all silhouettes including flags and smoke must fit within y=20..310; MIDDLE ROW within y=370..650; BOTTOM ROW within y=710..1000. Shrink the buildings uniformly if necessary to create these row gaps, but do not change their artwork. Keep ten objects only: town center, house, barracks, archery range / stable, farm, resource camp, siege workshop / blacksmith, watchtower, empty, empty. The town center must not overlap the stable beneath. The blacksmith smoke must stay entirely in bottom row and not cross into stable above. Each shape isolated with a wide empty transparent moat. No added frames, no text or background.

unit_visibility_corrections.english: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this six-sprite historical game atlas. Keep all SIX objects, their historical clothing, equipment, simple shapes, muted colors, proportions and exact order. Keep the 3x2 grid and add generous transparent gutters: top row fully within y=40..440, bottom row fully within y=560..970 in a 1536x1024 image, 45px minimum empty space left/right of each cell. Primary correction: the SIX OBJECTS must have COMPLETELY SOLID OPAQUE interiors (alpha 255), including all clothes, faces, boots, weapons, horses and wooden siege frame. They currently are partly translucent and look faded in-game. Only empty background and the very edge antialiasing should be transparent. Retain gentle matte gouache colors and sage-brown dark contours, no bright glossy highlights, no thick black ink, no added detail, no changes to faces or costume. No shadows except very small grounded foot shadows. No halos or blurred color washes. Fully transparent background. Keep all objects separated by empty transparent space without overlapping row bounding boxes. First row: empty-handed villager, warrior, archer. Second row: cavalry with spear, unarmed mounted scout, mangonel.
